title: MAX_SSE_BUF 1MiB: correct value but no test for the eviction path
description: MAX_SSE_BUF=1MiB is added in loop 6 and the check returns Err(SseFrameTooLarge) which triggers a reconnect. The value is correct: a single SSE frame is tiny (a few hundred bytes), so 1MiB gives plenty of headroom against any legitimate server. However there is no test that exercises the frame-too-large path in run_sse(). The unit test parse_sse_event does not reach run_sse. A test feeding bytes without a blank-line boundary until > 1MiB should verify the error is returned and the reconnect loop fires. Without a test, a future change to MAX_SSE_BUF or the buffer logic could silently regress the OOM protection.
